title: kernel-v1 fleet protocol budget (v1)
description: Versioned source of truth for the numeric and policy constants that bound the fleet protocol contracts (task 35: crates/protocol). Every protocol constant the bench harnesses and the Rust/TypeScript fixtures read is anchored here; any number not anchored here is a plan defect. The protocol uses typed state machines for policy activation (STAGE->READY->COMMIT->APPLIED/REJECTED) and event batch ACK (Pending->Accepted/Rejected). Deadlines propagate across RPC boundaries. Idempotency keys prevent duplicate processing. Message size bounds protect the control plane from oversized payloads.

max_message_size_bytes.description: Maximum serialized size of a single protocol message in bytes (1 MiB). A message exceeding this bound is rejected with OversizedMessage. The bound applies to each Event in a Batch and to each control-plane RPC message. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#max_message_size_bytes.

max_batch_messages.description: Maximum number of messages (events) per batch. A batch exceeding this count is rejected with OversizedBatch. The agent partitions its ring-buffer drain into batches no larger than this bound. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#max_batch_messages.

deadline_default_ms.description: Default deadline in milliseconds for protocol operations. Deadlines propagate across RPC boundaries: a child inherits the minimum of the parent's remaining budget and its own default. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#deadline_default_ms.

idempotency_key_format.description: The format of idempotency keys carried by every mutating RPC. Either a UUID v4 string or a monotonic u64 counter rendered as a decimal string. The server tracks seen keys and rejects duplicates with DuplicateIdempotencyKey. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#idempotency_key_format.

max_tracked_idempotency_keys.description: Maximum number of idempotency keys the server retains before evicting. Bounded memory prevents unbounded growth from long-running agents. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#max_tracked_idempotency_keys.

compression_algorithm.description: Compression algorithm for batch payloads. 'none' means no compression; 'zstd' means Zstandard. The bench harness reads this to configure the compression codec. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#compression_algorithm.

max_compressed_batch_bytes.description: Maximum compressed batch size in bytes. 0 means no limit beyond max_message_size_bytes * max_batch_messages. When non-zero, a compressed batch exceeding this bound is rejected. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#max_compressed_batch_bytes.

schema_major.description: The wire-format schema major version. Bumped on backward-incompatible wire changes. A client speaking a lower major is rejected with StaleProtocolMajor. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#schema_major.

schema_minor.description: The wire-format schema minor version. Bumped for additive changes that do not break existing field numbers. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#schema_minor.

fixture_min_precision_and_recall.description: Minimum precision and recall the protocol state machines must achieve on their declared fixture corpus (tests/fixtures/protocol/). Every state transition, error, and idempotency case must be covered. Anchored as bench/schemas/protocol.v1.json#fixture_min_precision_and_recall.
